description.text: WIN is a collaborative network of business incubators helping Western New York founders grow faster, strengthen their companies, and become more attractive to investors. Managed by University at Buffalo Business & Entrepreneur Partnerships, WIN connects startups to university talent, entrepreneurial support programs, and world-class facilities.

Incubate. Accelerate. WIN is a collaborative network of business incubators helping Western New York founders grow faster, strengthen their companies, and become more attractive to investors. Managed by University at Buffalo Business & Entrepreneur Partnerships, WIN connects startups to university talent, entrepreneurial support programs, and world-class facilities. Explore Incubators Get Support 0 Companies Served 0 Jobs Created $ 0 Million+ Funding Raised 0 Network Members Supported by UB Business & Entrepreneur Partnerships, funded through NYSTAR Innovation Hot Spot, and chartered by the WNY Regional Economic Development Council. Serving entrepreneurs across Allegany, Cattaraugus, Chautauqua, Erie, and Niagara counties. What WIN does Incubate WIN helps startups move from concept to traction with access to incubator spaces, mentors, and regional support. Support Founders can tap commercialization help, business guidance, and a broader ecosystem of talent and partners. Connect WIN links companies to UB resources, entrepreneurial networks, and funding-adjacent opportunities across Western New York. Why it Matters Incubation is more than space. WIN supports
